title: TOI-1258 b statistical validation: analysis code, inputs and results
description: Reproducible analysis for the statistical validation of TOI-1258.01 (TIC 288132261) as the planet TOI-1258 b. Includes the TESS transit fit with posterior samples, odd/even and secondary-eclipse checks, depth-versus-aperture and difference-image centroid tests, and TRICERATOPS false-positive analysis with corrected Gemini/'Alopeke contrast curves. Original code is licensed MIT; original documentation and derived result tables are licensed CC BY 4.0; third-party data (TESS, Gaia, ExoFOP follow-up) keep their own terms (see LICENSE_NOTICE.md). Statistical validation is not a mass measurement.
